TAG Heuer · ref. CBZ2080.FT8091

Formula 1 Chronograph

Motorsport Chronograph · 37–44mm · 200m · quartz

The TAG Heuer Formula 1 Chronograph is a motorsport-inspired watch known for its bold, colorful designs and robust functionality. Defining features include a tachymeter bezel for calculating speed, a highly legible dial with chronograph sub-dials, and a durable build intended for a fast-paced lifestyle.

The story

Launched in 1986, the Formula 1 collection was TAG Heuer's answer to the quartz crisis, offering a vibrant, accessible, and Swiss-made sports watch. The first chronograph models appeared around 1989, cementing the family's connection to motorsports. The series has seen several transformations, from the early fiberglass and steel cases to more premium materials like titanium and ceramic in later generations. After a brief discontinuation around the year 2000, the Formula 1 was successfully reintroduced in 2004 with a complete redesign and has since evolved to include both high-precision quartz and automatic movements, remaining a popular entry point to the brand.
